plan.scope: Default-OFF highsliceguard versus the matching merged empty-match parent; enabled recovery remains explicitly opt-in after its failed study.
plan.criterion: Every CPU/wall ratio-of-medians and simultaneous upper mean-ratio bootstrap bound <=5 percent. One final look; no unchanged-code repeat.
plan.execution: Eight comparisons on disjoint physical CPU pairs;384 paired rounds, balanced randomized order, no own builds/tests/captures/backends overlap.

lightwork_reservation_amendment.reason: Reserve a physical pair for light work; exclude it from workers before samples.

plan.failure_policy: Keep every observation and one final look. No unchanged-code repeat. Enabled recovery stays OFF in every preset regardless of this result.
